exposure: Placenta accreta (including subtypes: placenta accreta vera [PAV], placenta increta [PI], and placenta percreta [PP])
cohort: 84 cases of pathologically diagnosed placenta accreta and 51 controls without placenta accreta
finding: Placenta accreta vera (PAV) is a clinically symptomatic condition with distinct risk factors and clinical findings compared to advanced types of placenta accreta (PI and PP).
